evidence_census.scope: Historical audit and prior authenticated acceptance plus exact current installed-runtime, doctor, and recovery evidence; formal execution-consolidation qualification is represented separately as open work.

entries.reason: The attestation independently establishes historical closure at its frozen pre-conversation-first revision and remains explicitly stale for current-revision assurance.
The immutable authenticated report proves the exact manual lattice and provider-profile acceptance path without storing response text in the Surface.
The installed-runtime generation resolves the exact executable source, package, provider, and installed-byte inventories selected by launchd.
The verified snapshot is the current independently addressable recovery denominator.
The immutable doctor receipt establishes current installed runtime and local operational health without claiming formal closure.

evidence_sources.observation: The store, compositor, contracts, and independent reader implement direct or role-bound actors, atomic route-specific batches, exact derived context, overlapping episodes, durable run relationships, and independently reconstructable provider-facing manifests.

The supervisor, execution kernel, provider adapters, runtime identity, and workspace controls implement leased fresh, workspace-agent, native-continuation, cancellation, restart reconciliation, and fail-closed executable attestation.
Octopus import and governed workflow boundaries execute, while the complete authenticated German native-role exchange remains blocked by provider qualification.

The cockpit foregrounds response and composer, preserves latest-wins project state, exposes inline multi-provider and exact-selection actions, virtualizes long responses, and renders provider, transport, and backend failure distinctly.

The assurance tests reject incomplete consumer inventories, stale or mismatched installed runtimes, forged closure inputs, missing evidence, direct-provider resurrection, credential leakage, and unqualified retirement claims.

The canonical workframe contract states Lattice 0.3.1 as a conversation-first local harness, documents exact-context and provider-execution boundaries, and distinguishes implemented capability from formal execution-consolidation qualification.
Workflow tests exercise authoritative reads, exact state receipts, rejected mutation authority, query freezing, idempotency, restart ambiguity, bounded inputs, and Platform Foundry reuse.
The independent Audit Planes validator establishes closure over 39 findings at its frozen pre-rename revision; it remains historical assurance rather than a current-revision audit.

The canonical remediation ledger closes all 24 discriminated findings against exact runtime, semantic provider, responsiveness, restart, browser, and restore receipts while preserving provider-opacity and Gemini limits.

A content-bound authenticated report records 78 passed assertions across 18 immutable Claude and Codex invocations, including accepted v9 reciprocal cross-feed, exact provider-channel inspection, two rejected authority mutations, provider failure recovery, and a launchd restart with dormant-branch continuation.

The selected non-editable Lattice 0.3.1 runtime binds source revision 5c34733eabe4, installed module bytes, package inventory, provider executables, and provider attestations under Outport and launchd supervision.
The latest verified snapshot inventories the canonical database, append-only state, and content-addressed blobs for recovery; current separate-root continuation remains part of formal qualification.

The current installed-runtime doctor receipt passes runtime identity, provider attestation, database, append-chain, blob, migration, backup, service, and Outport checks while reporting formal closure as unqualified.
The execution-consolidation ledger retains seven S1/S2 findings in implemented-pending-verification state; none is represented as independently closed.
The active plan records the remaining durable-run dogfooding, executor adaptation, information-preserving progress UX, and primary-harness adoption program.

tree.label: Conversational lattice service

children.label: Execution and authority boundary
children.gloss: Outport-addressed loopback authority, snapshot recovery, and leased subscription-CLI execution with explicit profile qualification and durable failure state.
children.cohesion_basis: These artifacts share one operational obligation and change together at that boundary.

children.cohesion_basis: These artifacts share one operational obligation and change together at that boundary.

children.cohesion_basis: These artifacts share one operational obligation and change together at that boundary.

population_sanity.claim: The subject is a differentiated mechanism rather than an extensible population of peer instances.

paradigm_sweep.claim: Medium mode does not require a full paradigm sweep.

native_n_array.claim: Medium mode does not require a native child-count array.

one_ply_lookahead.claim: Durable run declarations, execution journals, provider adapters, runtime identity, and exact context manifests remain distinct views of the execution boundary rather than stable peer subsystems.

kind_homogeneity.claim: All five children remain operational capability subsystems: durable graph truth, execution authority, evidence integrations, conversational interaction, and release assurance.

incumbent_challenge.claim: A provider-, artifact-, or execution-stage carve would split each capability owner across transient stages; the incumbent operational-ownership carve still follows the boundaries that change and fail together.

judgment_calls.decision: Keep API hosting with execution rather than cockpit.
judgment_calls.alternative: Home server.py under the interface surface.
judgment_calls.reason: Its trust, lease, and workflow command boundary dominates its static-hosting role.

semi_lattice_signals.reason: The composition root legitimately connects API authority, workflows, and UI hosting while retaining one primary home.

claims.summary: Lattice natively authors direct or role-bound conversational graph edges, atomically seals route-specific batches, preserves exact context and overlapping episodes, relates durable runs to invocations, and independently reconstructs provider-facing manifests.

Outport authority, launchd supervision, leased attempts, typed failure, fresh and workspace execution, guarded native continuation, cancellation, durable-run recovery, snapshots, and fail-closed provider attestation execute; current authenticated profile and restored-continuation qualification remains unclosed.

Octopus exact-source import, declarative governed workflows, context modules, live concern-backed Slate slices, and Axial projection execute; complete authenticated German native-role acceptance remains unproven.

The same-origin cockpit supports direct and dual routing, side quests, exact grafts, compare, return, cross-feed, joins, dormant trailheads, latest-wins project navigation, virtualized long responses, visible context deltas, and typed failure surfaces.

Lattice 0.3.1 runs from a source- and byte-attested pinned environment under launchd supervision, and the current doctor passes runtime, provider, state, Outport, and backup checks; formal execution-consolidation closure remains unqualified.

Execution consolidation awaits an independently passing current-runtime bundle covering browser, authenticated providers, restart, separate-root restore, all registered consumers, historical imports, negative controls, and final finding closure.

The durable-work program is extending Lattice from conversational provider execution into the ordinary control plane for resumable local jobs, incremental evidence, resource-aware progress, and real-work dogfooding.

staleness.reason: The earlier whole-system audit remains historical assurance at its frozen pre-conversation-first revision.
The authenticated acceptance report proves the earlier conversation-first runtime, not the current installed runtime or current execution-consolidation closure.
